#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""A real recipe child holds its owned slot until a detached callback returns."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

name = sys.argv[1]
if name not in ('alpha', 'beta'):
    raise SystemExit(90)
ready = Path(f'{name}.ready')
temporary = ready.with_suffix('.tmp')
temporary.write_bytes(name.encode() + b'\n')
temporary.rename(ready)
result = Path('callback.done')
while not result.is_file():
    time.sleep(0.002)
Path(f'{name}.result').write_bytes(result.read_bytes())
